CustomObject.description: Microsoft Teams messages sent by TeamsMessageService from Flows (action "Send Custom Teams Message") or Apex (new TeamsMessageService.TeamsMessageRequest(customTeamsMessageName, recordId)). Each record defines the email template used as the message body; who receives it is defined by its Custom Email Recipient records (CustomEmailRecipient__mdt), which can also serve a Custom Email Alert.
CustomObject.label: Custom Teams Message
